t: Four phrases weighed against a whole morning
a: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رِضَا نَفْسِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ زِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
p: Subḥāna-llāhi ʿadada khalqih, subḥāna-llāhi riḍā nafsih, subḥāna-llāhi zinata ʿarshih, subḥāna-llāhi midāda kalimātih.
m: Glory be to Allah as many as His creation, glory be to Allah as pleases Him, glory be to Allah as the weight of His Throne, glory be to Allah as endless as His words.
